summary: What client resources add to the player's Discord activity. KCDS already shows each stage from startup through the menu to a server, with its logo, a timer and a link to its website. While the player is on a server, a resource can set the server's name, shown as "KCDS - <name>", the status line, the logo and small image with tooltips, and one button. KCDS's website button is always second, and the activity's type, timestamps, party and secrets stay with KCDS. Setters only prepare a field, and update() and setPresence() publish. Resources on one machine share one activity.

setName.summary: Prepares the server's name, up to 128 UTF-8 bytes. On the server, the line under KCDS reads "KCDS - <name>" rather than "Playing on <server>". The title stays KCDS. '' restores KCDS's line.
setName.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

Discord.setName("Rattay Roleplay")
Discord.update()

setState.summary: Prepares the status line, up to 128 UTF-8 bytes. update() publishes it while the player is on a server.
setState.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

kcds.core.Events.on("job:changed", function(job)
  Discord.setState("Working as a " .. tostring(job))
  Discord.update()
end)

setLargeImage.summary: Prepares the logo, an https image link of up to 128 UTF-8 bytes, shown on the server in place of the KCDS logo. '' restores the KCDS logo.

setLargeText.summary: Prepares the logo's tooltip, up to 128 UTF-8 bytes, shown on the server in place of the KCDS version.
setLargeText.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

Discord.setLargeText("Rattay Roleplay")
Discord.update()

setSmallImage.summary: Prepares the small image, up to 128 UTF-8 bytes. update() publishes it while the player is on a server.
setSmallImage.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

Discord.setSmallImage("https://example.com/icons/blacksmith.png")
Discord.setSmallText("Blacksmith")
Discord.update()

setSmallText.summary: Prepares the small image's tooltip, up to 128 UTF-8 bytes. update() publishes it while the player is on a server.
setSmallText.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

Discord.setSmallText("Level 12 blacksmith")
Discord.update()

setAssets.summary: Prepares the images and tooltips together.
setAssets.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

Discord.setAssets({ smallImage = "https://example.com/icons/guard.png", smallText = "On duty" })
Discord.update()

setButton.summary: Prepares the server's button, with a label of 1 to 32 UTF-8 bytes and an https link. It comes first on the server, and KCDS's "KCDS website" button is always second and cannot be removed. ('', '') removes the server's button. Discord shows buttons to people viewing the player's profile.
setButton.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

Discord.setButton("Join our Discord", "https://discord.gg/example")
Discord.update()

setPresence.summary: Prepares several fields and publishes them, as update() does.

params.options: { name?, state?, largeImage?, largeText?, smallImage?, smallText?, button? }, where button is { label, url } or null. Any other field throws.

setPresence.returns: boolean: false while the player's Discord app is not connected.
setPresence.exampleLua:
-- client
local published = kcds.ui.Discord.setPresence({ state = "Hunting near Ledetchko", smallImage = "https://example.com/icons/bow.png", smallText = "Hunter" })
if not published then
  print("Discord is not running")
end

update.summary: Publishes the prepared fields while the player is on a server.
update.returns: boolean: false while the player's Discord app is not connected.
update.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

Discord.setState("At the Rattay market")
Discord.update()

clear.summary: Removes resources' fields from the activity, leaving KCDS's presence.
clear.returns: boolean: false while the player's Discord app is not connected. Prepared fields are forgotten either way.
clear.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.core.Events.on("resourceStop", function(name)
  if name == "jobs" then
    kcds.ui.Discord.clear()
  end
end)

reset.summary: Forgets all prepared fields without publishing.

getUserId.summary: The Discord user signed in to the player's app, or '' until Discord has answered.
getUserId.exampleLua:
-- client
local discordId = kcds.ui.Discord.getUserId()
if discordId then
  kcds.core.Events.toServer("profile:discord", { discordId = discordId })
end

isAvailable.summary: Whether the player's Discord app is running and connected.
isAvailable.exampleLua:
-- client
local Discord = kcds.ui.Discord

if Discord.isAvailable() then
  Discord.setState("In a duel")
  Discord.update()
end
